dataset_info.title: Nirma University Scholarships, Admissions, GPS & Contact Dataset
dataset_info.purpose: Training/fine-tuning data covering Nirma University (Ahmedabad, India) scholarships, eligibility, application process, doubt-resolution contacts, and campus geolocation.

data_source_legend.verified: Compiled from Nirma University's official admissions site (admissions.nirmauni.ac.in) and other public sources found via web search, then paraphrased into structured form.
data_source_legend.synthetic: Not found in public sources; generated for completeness/training diversity. Treat as illustrative, NOT authoritative. Verify with the university before relying on it.

dataset_info.important_disclaimer: Scholarship amounts, ranks, dates, and fees change every admission cycle. Always cross-check with the official site (https://admissions.nirmauni.ac.in) or the relevant institute's admission office before making decisions. Entries marked 'synthetic' are fabricated placeholders for model training only.

general_process: Identify your target program (B.Tech, MBA, Law, etc.) and check the relevant entrance exam requirement (JEE Main for B.Tech, GUJCET/ACPC for state quota, IPMAT for Integrated BBA-MBA, CLAT for Law, GATE for M.Tech, etc.).
Register and fill the online application on the Nirma admissions portal (admissions.nirmauni.ac.in) or the specific institute's admission page.
Pay the non-refundable online application fee via Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking.
Upload required documents (mark sheets, entrance exam scorecard, category/income certificates if applicable).
Wait for the merit list / rank-based shortlist to be declared on the login dashboard.
Attend counselling (in-person or online, depending on category) and select an admission option (A/B/C/D) within the stipulated time.
Pay tuition and other fees online within the deadline to confirm the seat.
Report in person with original documents for verification on the notified date.

Scholarships in Categories I-III for B.Tech are auto-considered based on your entrance rank/category at the time of admission; no separate scholarship application form is typically required, but always confirm with the concerned institute since some scholarships (e.g., Needy Students' Fund, EWYL) require a separate request/application to the Director/HoI.

faq.question: Do I need my JEE (Main) All India Rank at the time of submitting the B.Tech application?
faq.answer: No. You can submit the application before your JEE (Main) rank is declared, but you must enter your correct JEE (Main) application number, roll number, and date of birth as per your admit card.

faq.question: Can a diploma holder get lateral entry into B.Tech at Nirma?
faq.answer: Lateral entry (Diploma-to-Degree) admissions are governed by ACPC (Admission Committee for Professional Courses), Government of Gujarat, not directly by the university. Follow ACPC's announced schedule and instructions.

faq.question: Is on-campus hostel available for B.Tech students?
faq.answer: No, at present Nirma University does not provide on-campus hostel facilities for B.Tech students; hostels are available for postgraduate program students. Guidance for off-campus accommodation is provided.

faq.question: Can I hold a Nirma scholarship together with the Gujarat government's MYSY scholarship?
faq.answer: No. Students receiving MYSY are not eligible for Nirma's own merit/merit-cum-means scholarships. Instead they can get supplementary support (up to Rs. 50,000/year) toward exam fees, books, and transport.

faq.question: Is there a dedicated scholarship for SC/ST students at the Institute of Management?
faq.answer: No separate scheme exists for reserved-category students at IMNU; MBA/BBA scholarships are awarded purely on merit and family income (merit-cum-means), regardless of category.

faq.question: Can I combine a Nirma merit scholarship with a private/external scholarship (e.g., a corporate CSR scholarship)?
faq.answer: This is not explicitly documented publicly; general renewal policy for several programs states a student should not be receiving a scholarship from another agency simultaneously, so external scholarships likely need to be disclosed and may disqualify continuation. Confirm in writing with your institute's admission office before accepting an external award.
